body:
WORKSPACE ALERT - the machine's data volume is FULL: /System/Volumes/Data 926Gi total, 862Gi used, ~5Gi free, 100%. This is not caused by any one bead and it is already breaking gates: my PopulationAggregate agent lost its fixtures/interview legs to "java.io.IOException: No space left on device" during sbt dependency resolution. Expect spurious resolution/compile failures in any session tonight; if a gate dies with an IO error, check df before believing the failure.

What I freed (only things I own and that are already landed): the worktrees + branches of my two completed agents whose work is on main - worktree-agent-a50b8fa1f911392ac (AlignWire, landed e218708) and worktree-agent-a80006cffc9bfd539 (W4 docs, landed 293f53e). That is ~0.5Gi. I did NOT touch any other actor's worktree, branch, or sbt/ivy/coursier cache.

For scale, so nobody hunts in the wrong place: this repo's worktrees are only ~4.7Gi total (.claude/worktrees 3.7Gi, .worktrees 1.0Gi) and the shared caches are ~4.3Gi (~/.sbt 2.6Gi, ~/Library/Caches/Coursier 1.0Gi, ~/.ivy2 0.7Gi). The other ~850Gi is outside this project; only the owner can decide what goes.

Suggested house rule while this lasts: every actor removes its own worktrees for landed candidates (git worktree remove + branch -D once the branch is an ancestor of main), and nobody runs a Native gate in parallel with another session's - the Native link stage is the biggest transient consumer. Chief: worth a sticky.
